# UQPAY React Native — error codes

<!-- Generated by `yarn errors:generate` from src/errors/table.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every `UqpayError` carries one of these codes. The set is produced by exactly one mapper
per platform, so the same server condition yields the same code on iOS and Android.
A code that is not in this table is passed through untouched with the native value in
`error.raw`, and `isUnknownErrorCode(code)` returns `true`.

**Outcome unknown** means the payment may still have succeeded: never show the customer a
failure, never charge again, and reconcile from your server.

| Code | Meaning | Retryable | Outcome unknown | What you should do | What the customer is told | Platforms |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `card_declined` | The issuer refused the card. | no | no | Read declineCode for the issuer reason. Do not retry the same card automatically; offer another method. | Your card was declined. Please try a different card or contact your bank. | ios, android |
| `insufficient_funds` | The issuer refused the card for lack of funds. | no | no | A decline sub-case. Offer another payment method rather than retrying. | Your card does not have enough funds for this payment. Please try a different card. | ios, android |
| `invalid_payment_method` | The card or wallet details were rejected as invalid before authorisation. | no | no | The customer can correct this in the sheet. If it repeats for every customer, check the intent and the enabled methods. | Those payment details could not be used. Please check them and try again. | ios, android |
| `3ds_failed` | The 3-D Secure challenge was not passed. | no | no | The challenge ran and the server rejected the outcome. Never infer this from the WebView URL; the server is the source of truth. | We could not verify this payment with your bank. Please try again or use a different card. | ios, android |
| `cancelled` | The payment was cancelled — surfaced as an error only when the native reports it as one. | yes | no | Most cancellations arrive as kind "canceled" with a reason. Treat this code the same way: nothing was charged. | This payment was cancelled. | ios, android |
| `authentication_failed` | The merchant auth token was missing, blank, rejected, or your tokenProvider did not answer in time. | yes | no | Your tokenProvider threw, returned a blank authToken, or did not settle within the native 10 s budget. Check your token endpoint and clientId. | We could not start this payment. Please try again in a moment. | ios, android |
| `invalid_configuration` | The SDK was asked to do something it cannot do with the given configuration. | no | no | A programmer error: a bad field, a sheet already presented, no foreground Activity / presenting view controller, or an option the platform does not support yet. The developer message names the field. | We could not start this payment. Please try again in a moment. | ios, android |
| `not_initialized` | A payment was requested before init() completed. | no | no | Await init() before presentPaymentSheet(). On iOS this code is derived by the bridge; the Android native emits it directly. | We could not start this payment. Please try again in a moment. | ios, android |
| `invalid_request` | The gateway rejected the request as malformed or unknown (HTTP 400, 404 or 422). | no | no | Strictly 400/404/422. Usually a bad paymentIntentId, an intent that belongs to another merchant, or a method the intent does not allow. Other definitive 4xx arrive as "unknown"; on iOS httpStatus carries the status, on Android it is absent. | We could not start this payment. Please try again in a moment. | ios, android |
| `network_error` | The device could not reach the gateway. | yes | no | Transport-level failure before the request was accepted. Safe to offer a retry; the natives replay with the same idempotency key. | We could not reach the payment service. Please check your connection and try again. | ios, android |
| `timeout` | The native exhausted its attempt budget, or the confirm left the device and no answer came back. | no | yes | Outcome unknown: the payment may still succeed. Arrives as the cause of a pending result. Reconcile from your server or via pending.reconcile(); never present again as a new payment. | This payment is taking longer than expected. We will confirm it shortly — please do not pay again. | ios, android |
| `server_error` | The gateway answered 5xx or 429 while the intent was being loaded. | yes | no | Load-path only. A 5xx on the confirm path is reported as pending + timeout instead, because the outcome is unknown there. On iOS this code is derived from the message when a status can be recovered. | The payment service is having trouble right now. Please try again in a moment. | ios, android |
| `intent_not_payable` | The intent is already in a terminal state and can no longer be paid. | no | no | The terminal-intent guard refused before any form was shown. A SUCCEEDED / REQUIRES_CAPTURE intent resolves completed and a CANCELLED one resolves canceled, so this code means FAILED. Create a new intent. | This payment can no longer be completed. | ios, android |
| `unknown` | A code neither bridge recognises. The raw native value is preserved in error.raw. | no | no | Report error.raw and error.httpStatus (iOS only; Android does not expose it) to UQPAY. Never report the payment as completed. This is the definitive no-failure-code fallback on both natives, so the outcome is known unless the per-occurrence isOutcomeUnknown flag says otherwise. | Something went wrong with this payment. Please try again or use a different method. | ios, android |

## Reading the columns

- **Retryable** — retrying the *same* action can plausibly succeed. A decline is not
  retryable; a transport failure is.
- **Outcome unknown** — the device cannot tell whether the money moved. Always reconcile.
- **What the customer is told** — the exact `error.userMessage`. It is safe to display as-is
  and contains no jargon, no stack trace and no platform name.
